parsed.reason: Both descriptions identify stale heap entries left behind after discard/re-add being treated as current, causing items to be evicted early based on old timestamps in LimitedSet.pop/purge. Description A attributes it to the removed _is_current check in pop(); Description B attributes it to discard() leaving stale heap entries plus purge() and pop() not validating entries, with extra detail on purge and revoked tasks. The core failure (stale heap entry for a re-added item evicts it early) is the same.
